Priya: Quick ask — BlackTail wants Private POC today. They prefer peering into our control plane and will NAT egress. Need a short handoff for their cloud eng.

Owen: Ask them for: all CIDRs, RTB IDs they'll modify, preferred AZs/subnets for peering, and NAT EIP(s). Confirm peering vs PrivateLink preference.

Priya: They sent 10.120.0.0/16 (apps) + 10.121.0.0/24 (onprem). Peering for POC.

Lena: Routing: customer add route -> dest 10.240.0.0/16 -> pcx-XXXX; our side add route -> dest 10.120.0.0/16 -> pcx-XXXX. Enable DNS resolution on peering. No 0.0.0.0/0 propagation.

Owen: Pasteable snippet for them: aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0abc --destination-cidr-block 10.240.0.0/16 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0abc123
Lena: SGs: allow TCP/443 from peered CIDRs to control-plane ENIs. We can give ENI IPs if they want least privilege. Also request NAT EIP(s) for outbound allowlisting.

ops-bot: Note: automated deployment will wait for peering acceptance. Create ticket to collect RTB IDs and NAT EIPs.

Priya: I'll send this and ask for RTB IDs, NAT EIPs, and whether they want us to accept peering via assume-role. Thanks.
